    initial_state = tuple(sorted([1] * N))

    visited = {initial_state}

        current_state_tuple, _ = queue.popleft()
        current_state = list(current_state_tuple)
        current_num_boxes = len(current_state)
        
        min_boxes = min(min_boxes, current_num_boxes)

            # Remaining boxes (excluding i and j)

            # Calculate the new boxes

            if next_state_tuple not in visited:

                queue.append((next_state_tuple, _ + 1))
